description: Open-domain historical aggregates calibrated for synthetic match context.

entries.source_license: Public domain, as declared by OpenFootball

text.en: In the 2016–17 Premier League season, teams leading by one goal at halftime won 113 of 156 matches (72.4%).
text.es: En la Premier League 2016–17, los equipos con un gol de ventaja al descanso ganaron 113 de 156 partidos (72,4 %).

caveat.en: Historical benchmark, not a prediction for this synthetic match.
caveat.es: Referencia histórica; no es una predicción para este partido sintético.
